details: RTX 3060 Laptop GPU with 6GB VRAM was insufficient for practical full SDXL evaluation.
Pipeline loading/inference without CPU offload exceeded available local VRAM.
Low-quality SDXL probe required several minutes per image, making full controlled evaluation impractical locally.
Faster low-step settings were not adequate for restoration-quality comparison; stronger settings were too slow.
SDXL was excluded because of local compute constraints, not because of a full comparative quality evaluation.
Full SDXL evaluation can be revisited with 12GB+ VRAM, preferably 16GB+.
